verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical and share the same faults. The 'SUNSET SALE' title is shrunk to tiny text sitting on a cropped, clipped circle at the bottom edge, and the logo is shrunk into a footnote next to the fine print, so the brand header is lost. The decorative circles are scattered fragments, and one sits awkwardly behind the CTA. A is slightly worse: its CTA button almost touches the right edge, its product box crowds the left edge, and its footer row is cramped. B keeps marginally better side margins.
